text: Figure 3.8: Specialized LinCommunicationController attributes (Fibex4Lin_Topology) [constr_5252] LinSlaveConfig.protocolVersion shall exist ⌈The attribute LinSlaveConfig.protocolVersion shall be defined at the time the Base EcuC is created.⌋() Note that the AUTOSAR BSW only supports LIN masters. LIN slaves are seen as non AUTOSAR ECUs. They can be described in the System T emplate in order to configure the LIN Interface for the master correctly , but AUTOSAR does not support the development of LIN slaves as of AUTOSAR release 4.0 ([15], [16]). emplate
